sources.label: Pokémon GO related and other patches for apps I use.
sources.author: DanielTheManiel
patch_list: Routes Google Play Services to MicroG-RE (app.revanced.android.gms) and pins Poke Genie's legacy sign-in path so Google sign-in works on the re-signed app. Install MicroG-RE, add your account there. Minimal: no push/FCM.

Neutralizes PairIP for Poke Genie end to end: skips the startup program (integrity check + Play-Store paywall) and restores its tables, nukes the Java license/signature checks, stops the native VM (so virtualized methods no-op and nothing…
Forces premium flags and server getters to true/max by short-circuiting their methods.
